verdicts.reason: A uses the landscape shape well with the book on the left and copy on the right, but the 'See the List' button sits in the top-right corner above the headline, cut off from its copy and out of reading order. The text block also floats in the upper half, leaving the bottom-right empty, and 'recommending.' wraps onto a line by itself. B is just the portrait layout shrunk into a thin centre column with large dead areas on both sides, and at that size the book title and footer text are tiny, so it does not fit the format at all.
